package.name: homemy_drivebase
package.description: Differential drive of HomeMy: two ESS23-RS closed-loop motors on one RS485 bus (Modbus RTU). Ported from the Amadeus base_hardware package. Non-moving by default: dry run, RS485 writes disabled, encoder path locked until commissioning. The Modbus library is installed with pip, see requirements-modbus.txt.
